correctness.rationale: The source full preprint establishes its sharp M_n via the monotone-path action I_n(T)=int_{-1}^1 (1-tT(t))^{n/2} sqrt(T prime(t)) dt and proves the cone lower profile M_n>=2^{(n+2)/2}/(n+1). For increasing absolutely continuous endpoint-normalized T, 1-tT<=2 and Cauchy-Schwarz yields int sqrt(T prime)<=sqrt(2(T(1)-T(-1)))=2, so I_n(T)<=2^{n/2+1} uniformly. Hence n-th roots sandwich M_n between sqrt2 times a factor tending to 1 and sqrt2. The ball benchmark B_n=Gamma(1/2)Gamma(n/2+1)/Gamma((n+3)/2) has B_n^2~2pi/n; the exact ratio R_n=(M_n/B_n)^2 therefore has R_n^{1/n}->2 and log R_n=n log 2+O(log n). This proof is analytic, covers integer n>=1 and does not pretend to determine polynomial prefactors.
